claim_boundary: Scorecard is reporting metadata for campaign credibility dimensions; it is not benchmark proof, paper evidence, or real-world validation.

factors.description: Repository and campaign checks supporting correct implementation.
factors.justification: Report was generated from structured campaign summary/table artifacts; test-suite evidence is not embedded in the campaign artifact.

factors.description: Comparison against trusted real-world or independent reference data.
factors.justification: No campaign artifact supplied enough evidence for this factor.

factors.description: Pinned inputs, hashes, manifests, and source provenance.
factors.justification: Campaign records git commit and scenario matrix hash; external input lineage remains limited to recorded artifacts.

factors.description: Seed repetition, confidence intervals, or variance analysis.
factors.justification: Campaign records 3 seed(s) and seed-variability artifacts when available; no claim beyond campaign-level uncertainty.

factors.description: Coverage across planners, scenarios, and non-success classifications.
factors.justification: Campaign reports 6/6 successful planner row(s); fallback/degraded rows remain caveats, not success evidence.

factors.description: Prior accepted use of this campaign configuration or equivalent evidence.
factors.justification: No campaign artifact supplied enough evidence for this factor.
